resources.string: Enable diagnostics and consent controls. Host shell requires separate consent; disabling revokes it immediately.

Allow “%1$s” on local system %2$s to request host shell, APK installation, and Logcat access for up to 30 minutes?
Plugin: %3$s
Version: %4$s

Commands can change host files. Android permissions and existing approvals still apply. Consent is not saved and expires on revocation, timeout, restart, or disabling developer mode. Existing effects cannot be rolled back. PRoot shares the app UID and does not provide strong isolation.
